title: Israeli Airstrike Destroys Al-Muttaqin Mosque and Displacement Tents Near Yarmouk Stadium
detail: The Israeli military struck and destroyed Al-Muttaqin Mosque in Gaza City, located next to Yarmouk Stadium where dozens of displaced Palestinians were sheltering in tents. Footage showed people evacuating shortly before the strike, indicating a narrow evacuation warning was given, though the explosion destroyed the mosque and surrounding tents, leaving hundreds homeless and injuring several Palestinians. The IDF said the mosque was one of several sites in central and northern Gaza used by Hamas as weapons depots; Palestinian officials rejected the claim.

media.caption: Israeli airstrike destroys Al-Muttaqin Mosque next to a displacement camp in Gaza City — July 28, 2026
